sampling: 160 points in each of 9 ESA WorldCover classes; 1440 points; 1292 distinct Naturebase pixels. Full country check uses native cell centres.
acquisition_scope: Naturebase top-level CSV/TXT/TIF members fetched by HTTP ranges; selected member CRC verified and SHA256 recorded. Original whole ZIP not acquired/hashed; selected.zip hashes refer to locally assembled subsets. GDB members inventoried only, not inspected. PEATMAP North America original ZIP acquired and SHA256 recorded.
numeric_use: No high/medium/low/none classification or carbon-loss threshold introduced. Naturebase zero-valued raster and NA tables do not establish absence of peat or opportunity.
